overview: The Charter Study Committee reviewed resident survey results, voted to propose a municipal compensation advisory board in the charter, and discussed draft sections governing the mayor and city council. Subcommittees were also organized for elections and citizen participation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the February 1, 2024 meeting.

items.title: Survey Results Presentation
items.summary: David Zabner presented findings from 666 survey responses, highlighting broad respondent support for a mayor-council system, four-year mayoral terms, combined ward and at-large representation, and term limits.

items.title: Elected Official Compensation and Advisory Board
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to recommend charter language creating a seven-member citizen compensation advisory board to review mayoral, city council, and school committee salaries every two years and submit reports to the council.

items.title: Articles 2 and 3 Charter Language Review
items.summary: Members reviewed drafted provisions for the city council and mayor, agreeing to hold a provisional vote on both articles at the March meeting.

items.title: Subcommittee Assignments and Term Length Discussion
items.summary: Members volunteered for subcommittees on Article 7 (Elections) and Article 8 (Citizen Participation), and discussed the administrative obstacles to implementing three-year terms or spring elections.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident thanked the committee for its work.
